rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for disciplinary punishment imposed by a parent, teacher, or other authority.

example.english: After getting his homework wrong so many times, the teacher decided on punishment.
example.traditional: 做錯咁多次功課，老師決定要懲罰佢。
example.jyutping: zou6 co3 gam3 do1 ci3 gung1 fo3 lou5 si1 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 cing4 fat6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for a formal or legal penalty, especially one imposed for a crime, rather than ordinary discipline.

example.english: If you break the law, you have to face punishment.
example.jyutping: faan6 faat3 zau6 jiu3 zip3 sau6 jing4 fat6

rows.note: Use this for the hardship or suffering caused by rough treatment or a harsh experience, not for an official penalty.

example.english: They have always bullied people, and now they have finally got a taste of punishment.
example.traditional: 佢成日蝦蝦霸霸，今次終於食到苦頭喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 haa1 haa1 baa3 baa3 gam1 ci3 zung1 jyu1 sik6 dou2 fu2 tau4 laa3
